title: Yvonne Louro Promoted by Kearny Bank to1st Vice President / CRA Officer – Governance & Advisory Manager
summary: Neptune resident Yvonne Louro has been elevated by Kearny Bank to the position of 1st Vice President / CRA Officer – Governance & Advisory Manager.
body_markdown:
**FAIRFIELD, NJ (Sept. 17, 2026)** – Neptune resident Yvonne Louro has been elevated by Kearny Bank to the position of 1st Vice President / CRA Officer – Governance & Advisory Manager. Her responsibilities include oversight of the bank’s Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) program, Compliance Fair Lending analytics program, and compliance governance activities.


“Yvonne has built an impressive career, consistently expanding her expertise and responsibilities,” says Kearny Bank Senior Vice President / Chief Compliance Officer Silvia Merino-Topley. “Her leadership of our CRA, Fair Lending, and compliance governance activities is central to ensuring we meet regulatory obligations and remain responsive to our clients. This promotion recognizes her valuable contributions.”


A Monmouth University graduate, she holds a bachelor’s degree in business administration with a concentration in accounting. She also has earned CRCM certification from the American Bankers Association; CRACP certification from CRA Today; and FLE certification from Tuscan Club University.


Louro’s community involvement includes interaction with Junior Achievement of New Jersey, Alaris Health, and the All-Stars Project.


**About Kearny Bank**


Combining the finest traditions of community banking with the industry’s latest, most effective financial products and services, Kearny Bank provides business and personal clients with the tools for success. Established back in 1884, and now operating from corporate offices in Fairfield, NJ, Kearny Bank’s footprint covers most of New Jersey, along with Brooklyn and Staten Island.
